meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先分析你 fork 里的改动,把配置、源码等定制整理成一份可回放的迁移指南;升级时以干净的上游代码为基础,按指南重新应用这些定制,不依赖 git merge。
howto.when: 当你调用该技能要求升级 NanoClaw fork 时触发。它会先刷新自身、检查工作区,再对比分支差异评估规模后进入提取或升级阶段。

say.text: 用迁移指南的方式帮我升级这个 NanoClaw fork。
say.note: Claude 会检查工作区并开始提取定制。

say.text: 先提取我的定制生成迁移指南,再在干净上游上重放。
say.note: 跳过 merge,按指南重建你的改动。

say.text: 看看我的 fork 和上游差多少,属于哪一档。
say.note: Claude 会评估差异规模并给出路径。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude analyzes your fork's changes, organizes config/source customizations into a replayable migration guide, and on upgrade reapplies them on a clean upstream base instead of using git merge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to upgrade a NanoClaw fork with this skill. It refreshes itself, checks for a clean tree, compares divergence from upstream, then enters extract or upgrade.

say_en.text: Help me upgrade this NanoClaw fork using the migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude checks the worktree and starts extracting customs.

say_en.text: Extract my changes into a guide, then reapply on clean upstream.
say_en.note: Skips merge and rebuilds your edits from the guide.

say_en.text: Assess how far my fork diverges from upstream.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates scope and picks the right path.
